title: Tenant SLO budgeting tied to usage & billing alerts
creator: Aisha Thompson
description:
Problem: Our current SLOs for analytics ingestion and console routes are global or tenant-agnostic, which means high-usage tenants can consume disproportionate SLO budget and cause noisy alerts or undetected billing overruns. Teams often scramble during billing surprises because we do not surface projected invoice deltas alongside SLO burn rates.

Goal: Implement a per-tenant SLO budgeting system that ties tenant usage tiers and billing projections to SLO weights and alerting thresholds. The feature should: compute a daily "SLO budget" for each paying tenant derived from their current billing plan and 30-day usage trend, expose burn-rate metrics and projected overage indicators in our telemetry pipeline, correlate slowdowns to tenant-level traces and top contributing queries, and raise combined operational/billing alerts when projected spend or SLO burn exceed configured thresholds.

Why this helps: Operators can prioritize remediation for tenants that both negatively impact platform reliability and risk billing disputes. Product and finance can proactively notify customers and offer mitigation (rate limit suggestions, recommended Dedicated capacity) before invoices post. This reduces incident churn, lowers surprise churn, and improves trust for larger customers.

Scope and non-goals: Scope includes: metric derivation in the analytics pipeline, SLO export changes, alert rules, dashboards, a small Console surface to show per-tenant budget and projections, and runbook/playbook. Non-goals: automated billing adjustments (finance-owned), automatic throttling of tenant traffic, or authorizing spend on behalf of customers.

Data model summary: daily_slo_budget{tenant_id, tier, window=30d}, slo_burn_rate{tenant_id, route, time_window}, projected_invoice_delta{tenant_id, projection_days=7}, top_query_latency_contrib{tenant_id, query_signature}. These metrics should be exportable to our metrics store and available for dashboards and alerts.
acceptance_criteria: Per-tenant SLO budget metric computed and emitted once per day for 95% of active tenants (metric name: daily_slo_budget) and documented in telemetry contract
SLO burn-rate exported per-tenant and per-route with 1m granularity and visible in the metrics explorer
Combined alert rule: when projected_invoice_delta > 10% AND slo_burn_rate > 0.5 for >30m, send alert to oncall + tenant-billing Slack channel and create a PagerDuty incident with tenant tag
New Console dashboard 'Tenant SLO Budget' added with burn-rate heatmap, projected spend line, top 5 contributing routes, and quick links to traces and billing invoice history
Feature gated behind feature flag and rolled out to 10 pilot tenants with runbook verified and playbook steps tested
Security review completed and data access controls enforced so only authorized roles can view per-tenant billing-projection metrics
tasks: Design metric mapping and formula for converting usage tiers to SLO weight (owner: Luca)
Implement projection job in analytics pipeline to compute projected_invoice_delta (owner: pipeline team)
Add tenant tags to trace sampling for high-burn tenants and ensure trace linkage to metrics (owner: tracing infra)
Create SLO exporter for per-tenant metrics and wire into existing SLI catalog (owner: telemetry)
Create alert rules in monitoring stack and test alert routing to Slack/PagerDuty (owner: oncall tooling)
Build Console dashboard and a minimal UI panel to show SLO budget + suggested actions (owner: console-frontend)
Author runbook/playbook and validate with incident drill for a simulated high-burn tenant (owner: reliability)
Coordinate with Finance to validate projection logic against billing pipeline (owner: product-ops)
